items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-08-01
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] Tom, uh, uh, uh, uh, Tommy Griffin. Tom Griffin.

ctx.x: You know, I should remember this. Every Saturday morning we played on there. I should remember these Sunday concerts. It says, opening today, Sunday, September 4th, 1949. It's just about the time I came here. It was in the American Legion Crystal Room. 334. Well, that was on Royal Street, yes. But I really don't remember that. Back to corner of Conta. That may have been just before I got here.
Tom, uh, uh, uh, uh, Tommy Griffin. Tom Griffin.
I talked to, uh, Harvey Blackstone, who wrote Bourbon Street Bounce yesterday. Do you remember Bourbon Street Bounce?
